reference.title: Transcoding Settings Reference
reference.shortdesc: What happens to a recording after you upload it, and what you can control.

section.title: Automatic renditions
section.p: Every upload is automatically transcoded into 1080p, 720p, and 480p renditions so viewers get a resolution matching their connection.

section.title: Pro-tier options
section.p: Pro accounts can additionally request a 4K rendition (source permitting) and can disable the lower renditions to save storage.
